headline: August regular investment amount hits second-highest on record; retail and day-trading enthusiasm rebounds
summary: The Taiwan Stock Exchange reported August regular investment of NT$36.878 billion, up from July and just behind June's record of NT$37.52 billion. Small investors and long-term dividend investors supported the figure.
why: The Taiwan Stock Exchange is the island's main equity venue, and regular-investment flows indicate retail participation in its main board.
